scLDM.count_contract_finding: The shipped VAE configuration selects a negative-binomial decoder; LatentDiffusion.sample decodes latent samples and returns NB draws. Count-valued generation is source-supported, so absence of a count likelihood is not a valid exclusion.
scLDM.conditioning: Sampler accepts condition and guidance dictionaries. Exact stage-only ALZ conditioning and train-only vocabulary remain unexecuted.
scLDM.depth_contract: Public sampler draws log-size factors internally by condition. Matching the fixed fitting-only ALZ library trace needs an explicit native-decoder integration and replay check.
scLDM.remaining: Fresh local VAE/LDM training, checkpoint restoration, exact condition/count/depth/scoring adapter, fullwidth CPU/native checks and measured shared-resource requirements. No real ALZ fit or score.

SAVE.source_contract: Public conditional-generation path fits MaxAbsScaler, decodes and clamps continuous outputs, then inverse-transforms them. No native integer-count draw was found in the reviewed generation path.
SAVE.inference: It does not directly meet this frozen benchmark integer-count contract. Rounding or adding an observation distribution would be an adapted method and must be declared; this finding does not rank SAVE expression-distribution quality.
SAVE.remaining: A separately specified continuous-expression comparison or a justified, disclosed count adapter; preserve original model rather than silently substituting a weakened implementation.

count_FM.count_contract: Native nonnegative integer unit-jump sampler and scRNA adapter are present. Source supports direct count-space generation.
count_FM.conditioning: Generic conditional count networks have upstream covariate-dropout checks; the scRNA adapter inspected is unconditional. A stage-only ALZ integration is not yet tested.
count_FM.sampling_contract: The scRNA sampler defaults to500 first-order unit-jump steps; adequacy for fitting count ranges, library variation and convergence must be checked before fair ALZ evaluation.
count_FM.remaining: Fresh conditional ALZ adapter, fixed recipe declared before new evaluation, full2000gene/native CPU qualification, checkpoint/count/depth replay and measured shared GPU feasibility. No real ALZ fit or score.

count_flow_map.status: Count-space one/few-step method identified in the primary paper; code/task eligibility not established here.

claim_scope: A completed frozen45 comparison can establish results against its tested recipes on this historical ALZ protocol. Additional applicable methods and independent-cohort evidence remain separate requirements for broader claims.
